description: Repairs r-expr-1/mut-validation-rules: V = 5 alone cannot tell a truth value from a comparison. Asks, for each bare-literal field rule (Null, 0, 2, '', '1', 'q', True, False) on its own fresh table Vr<i> (TableDefs refreshed before the field is read): the rule is set and read back, then AddNew/Update with V = 5, 0, 2, -1, Null and V unassigned, each on a newly opened recordset, with Errors and EditMode read after each Update; the stored rows follow. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
